elaine: Hey team — quick win to share: CloudSmith has signed to list Redwood Inference on the AWS Marketplace as an ISV partnership. Listing went live ~10m ago. :tada:

marta: Amazing! Can marketing get a 1-pager and tweet-ready copy?

raj: Sales — we already have a pilot lined up with Finova. I'll send the contract addendum and propose a joint press note.

sam: Eng here — helped with the AMI and private images. Validated metering + billing flow with AWS Metering API. Quick log: `aws-mktg-usage-report: OK`.

marketplace-bot: Listing status changed to 'Active' by elaine at 1764501220

elaine: Thanks Sam — PSA: verification steps for private deployments are in the PR: https://git.internal/r/integration/cloudsmith-aws (see checklist in the PR description).

casey: Huge — can we get a short case study (1 page) and an exec quote? Happy to provide a few lines.

marta: I'll draft the blog + social. Goal: publish Thursday EOB. Need 2 dev quotes and one customer quote. @raj can you coordinate with Finova for the customer quote?

raj: On it — pinging Finova now and requesting a 15-min quote call this week. Also prepping revenue uplift estimate for Q4.

sam: FYI we enabled a fallback model variant for the marketplace SKU to ensure SLA compliance. Config snippet:
```
model_variant: r-infer-small-latency
fallback_policy: regional
```

elaine: Next steps (owners): marketing draft = marta, engineering onboarding runbook = sam, customer outreach = raj. I'll schedule a 30-min sync to align launch comms and enablement.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created by elaine for 1764501400 — calendar: Partnerships Sync (30m)

marta: Draft posted: https://notion.redwood/team/cloudsmith-marketplace-draft — feedback welcome, posting a short social queue in the doc.

raj: Great work everyone. This should open more ISV listing conversations. :rocket:
